name: Wield Probe (research)
description: Research only, for W's King of Hearts: can a mod put a GL-21 in your Helldiver's hands, fill it to 40 rounds and give your own weapon back? Logs the game's weapon switches; In a mission with no support weapon carried, Insert puts a GL-21 with 40 rounds in your hands; Delete gives your weapon back. Solo or host. Turn off when done.
